name: Bug report
about: Something in Software City doesn't behave as documented.
title: "[bug] "
labels: ["bug"]
assignees: []

---

## What happened

A clear, short description. What did you do, what did you expect, what did you see?

## Language and code

What language is the project you were looking at? A minimal snippet of the file (or a class/function) is best.

```ts
// or .py, .gd, .go, .java, .cs, .kt, ...
```

## What I expected

Which call/class/field was wrong, missing, or in the wrong place.

## Screenshot

If the bug is visual (city, diagram, library), drop a screenshot. Click-drag to copy an image.

## Browser

- Browser and version: e.g. Chrome 138, Firefox 132, Safari 18
- OS: macOS 15 / Windows 11 / Ubuntu 24
- File size: how many files did you load

## Build

- `git rev-parse HEAD`
- `npm run build` output (last 20 lines, only if it failed)

## Licence

By submitting this issue you agree it may be redistributed under Software City's licence terms.
